hook: Nobody mentions this about automation triggers.
sentences: A trigger is like a doorbell that starts everything.
You set it, but nothing happens until the knock arrives.
A filter then decides if that knock matches your rule.
The action runs the work once the filter approves.
Demo: weak prompt "When I get an email, do something." Better: "When I receive an email from boss, create a task."
Adding an alert step tells you when the flow fails silently.
